defect: D6 — GPT-2 tokenizer has no padding token
exception: ValueError: Asking to pad but the tokenizer does not have a padding token. Please select a token to use as `pad_token` (tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token e.g.) or add a new pad token via tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'pad_token': '[PAD]'})
why_only_gpt2: Qwen's tokenizer already defines a pad token; GPT-2's does not. After G2 routed CALF/TimeCMA back to GPT-2, they hit it.

behaviour: if absent and eos_token_id exists, set pad_token to the EXISTING eos token (no new vocabulary entry, no embedding resize);
fail closed when neither pad nor eos exists;
Qwen forward passes a combined attention mask (patch token mask = 1);
CALF pools/aligns and computes its regularization loss on the last NON-PADDING token;
TimeCMA retrieves the last NON-PADDING token via the mask;
Qwen behaviour is unchanged because its pad token already exists.
